name: Dreamoon and Sums
description: Dreamoon loves summing up something for no reason. One day he obtains two integers a and b occasionally. He wants to calculate the sum of all nice integers. Positive integer x is called nice if and , where k is some integer number in range [1, a ] . By we denote the quotient of integer division of x and y . By we denote the remainder of integer division of x and y . You can read more about these operations here: http://goo.gl/AcsXhT . The answer may be large, so please print its remainder modulo 1 000 000 007 ( 10 9 + 7 ). Can you compute it faster than Dreamoon?
input_specification: The single line of the input contains two integers a , b ( 1 ≤ a , b ≤ 10 7 ).
output_specification: Print a single integer representing the answer modulo 1 000 000 007 ( 10 9 + 7 ).
approach_summary: Precompute linear sieve to store minimum prime factor (spf[x]) up to N in O(N). Factorize any number x ≤ N in O(log x) steps.
